confirm.scrobbleRiskContent:
Scrobbling is still experimental. Reported listening records are not guaranteed to count as valid plays, and the associated risks are not yet fully understood.
Enabling it may trigger account risk controls or other account security issues. Consider the potential risks carefully before enabling this feature.
confirm.highResourceContent: Enabling it may noticeably increase memory and CPU usage, and could cause stuttering on lower-end devices. Enable it anyway?
confirm.transitionHighResourceContent:
Playback transitions are resource-intensive and are intended for users with higher-performance devices.
This feature is still in testing, and for some tracks the transition may currently sound worse than a plain track change.
Enabling it also turns on track preloading, song caching and streaming caching, which increases memory, CPU, network and disk usage. Enable it anyway?
confirm.restartRequiredContent: This setting requires an app restart. Save and relaunch now?
confirm.testChannelContent: Beta and Alpha channels receive test releases early. Alpha releases may be highly unstable. Switch anyway?
confirm.kugouLoginVersionContent: After switching, the current credentials will not match the new version. You must log out and scan the QR code again, or VIP privileges and high-quality playback will stop working. Switch anyway?
confirm.exclusiveModeContent: Exclusive mode bypasses the system mixer and prefers the source sample rate and bit depth, making it suitable for external DACs / Hi-Fi gear. Player volume, EQ and other processing still apply, so bit-perfect output is not guaranteed. Other apps may be unable to play audio while exclusive. If exclusive mode is unavailable, shared mode will be attempted; it may also fail if another app holds the device exclusively. Switch anyway?
confirm.preloadCacheTitle: Enable the caches required for preloading?
confirm.preloadCacheContent: Preloading requires caching the next track's audio. Continuing will enable both song caching and streaming caching, which may increase network traffic and disk usage
confirm.disableSongCacheContent: Preloading and crossfade depend on the song cache and will be disabled as well
